name: Resolv USD
oneLiner: USR was Resolv Labs's delta-neutral synthetic dollar; it was frozen in 2026 after an EOA-minter exploit produced 80M unbacked tokens and depegged the asset.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Direct retained: incident reporting and the local obituary record that Resolv burned unbacked USR supply via a blacklist freeze after the March 2026 exploit.

obituary.epitaph: When one key minted eighty million
obituary.obituary: On 22 March 2026, an attacker exploited Resolv's single-EOA minter — no oracle, no amount cap, no max-mint guard — depositing 100K USDC and receiving 50M USR in return, then iterating until 80M unbacked USR existed for ~$25M of extracted ETH. USR crashed to $0.025 in 17 minutes; the RLP insurance layer absorbed the bad debt and was wiped out, dragging Stream Finance's $17M position down with it. Resolv burned 46M of the unbacked supply via a blacklist freeze, but USR never recovered — by April it traded at $0.16 with $95M of collateral against $173M of liabilities. Delta-neutral collateral and Apostro-attested reserves were no defense against an operator-level privilege failure.

collateral: ETH, wstETH (Lido), LBTC, and weETH held on-chain via Fireblocks; yield from liquid staking rewards and perpetual futures funding rates
pegMechanism: Delta-neutral portfolio: long spot ETH/BTC on-chain balanced by equal short perpetual futures on CEXs (Binance, Hyperliquid, Deribit) via Fireblocks Off-Exchange; USR redeemable 1:1 at any time; RLP (Resolv Liquidity Pool) absorbs negative funding-rate and liquidation risk

mintAuthority.summary: USR minting was gated by an off-chain backend: users deposited collateral on-chain via requestSwap, then an off-chain SERVICE_ROLE signer attested the USR amount and completed the mint via completeSwap. The minting contract performed no oracle, ratio, per-tx, or max-supply check, and the SERVICE_ROLE was a single EOA whose compromise let an attacker mint 80M unbacked USR in March 2026.

mintIncidents.summary: A compromised off-chain SERVICE_ROLE key and unchecked mint parameters let the attacker mint about 80M unbacked USR and extract roughly $25M.

controls.label: Resolv SERVICE_ROLE off-chain minting signer

routeChecks.signingModel: requestSwap/completeSwap relied on an off-chain SERVICE_ROLE backend signer; incident reporting describes a single EOA AWS-KMS key compromise.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: Minting contract performed no oracle, ratio, per-transaction, or max-supply check tying minted USR to deposited collateral.
routeChecks.unsupportedReason: Post-exploit SERVICE_ROLE holder set still includes multiple contracts/signers; this frozen asset remains scored as unbounded/compromised.

controls.evidence: Post-mortem and incident analyses describe a requestSwap/completeSwap flow where the minted USR amount is supplied by an off-chain SERVICE_ROLE backend (single EOA, AWS-KMS key) with no on-chain validation tying minted amount to deposited collateral; its compromise produced 80M unbacked USR.

controls.label: Admin Safe (DEFAULT_ADMIN, token owner)

routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: Admin Safe holds DEFAULT_ADMIN/token owner posture and can authorize SERVICE_ROLE changes; reviewed as 4-of-6 Safe v1.3 with no modules or guard.
routeChecks.caps: Admin can manage roles, but the compromised mint route had no effective on-chain collateral or max-supply bound.

controls.evidence: At block 25295177: USR token owner() = 0xd6889f…; Blockscout: GnosisSafeProxy; getThreshold() = 4; getOwners() returned 6 addresses; masterCopy slot0 = 0xd9db270c… (Safe v1.3); guard slot = 0x0; modules empty. DEFAULT_ADMIN RoleGranted to this Safe is active (initial 0x8729dae was revoked).

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295177: USR token (0x66a1e37…) is a TransparentUpgradeableProxy; impl = 0xef4c4bc… (ContractName 'SimpleToken', SERVICE_ROLE-gated mint/burn); proxy admin = 0x44a41b… (ProxyAdmin contract), ProxyAdmin owner = 0x290d954… (large contract, 16090 bytes). Token owner() = 0xd6889f… (GnosisSafeProxy): 6 owners, 4/6 threshold, Safe v1.3, no modules (getModulesPaginated returned empty), no guard (storage slot = 0x0). DEFAULT_ADMIN RoleGranted: originally 0x8729dae (revoked) + 0xd6889f (Safe, active). SERVICE_ROLE: 13 RoleGranted, 5 RoleRevoked; current active holders: 0xa27a69 (contract 24938 bytes), 0xac85ef (contract 27892 bytes), 0x60a7b7, 0x9f805f, 0x36c9b5, 0xd6889f (Safe), 0x1202f5. Multiple backend signers remain post-exploit; coin is frozen since 2026-04-27.
